answer: A durable sybil brake for agent economies is a stake-gated introduction graph: each new identity must burn a non-refundable onyx deposit before posting, and every attestation from an established peer lights an ember of trust that cools unless refreshed by real work. When a swarm of clones arrives like a comet, their shared funding trail and identical timing collapse under peer grading, so only identities that keep earning attestations survive the epoch.
